what: Seventh round of the 3D cascades (web/shaders/cascades3d): the cache gather's dark fallback, sv 2's brightening and the bright bands on raw-hall, on the default J2 (round 6, evidence/cascades3d-cost-rtx4090.json: jit 8, tf 32, sv 2, ft 1, cg 2; 1080p RMSE 0.082 (0.077 to 0.088), bias +1.3%, GI 5.0 ms, worst leak 0.39%, 4K 10.2 ms). Round 6 found every cg mode 1.05% low on 10 of 96 pixels of the CPU white furnace at grid g2
written: 2026-11-07, after the CPU code of pi, cg 4 and fd was written, and after an exploratory CPU furnace diagnosis (listed under exploration, below); before any leak run, GPU run, raw-hall measurement, render or parity run
source_read: J. Tollenaar, 'Split Radiance Cascades' (article, author's save, batch 36; read as data, nothing run). What applies here: probes buried in geometry are a cause of leaks and dark splotches; rays from real surface points avoid them. Used as the reason to test probes for being buried (pi) and to fall back to rays from the surface point to the probes (cg 4). The article's own merge (transmittance-weighted bins) and hashed sparse probes are not built this round

exploration.note: CPU float64 furnace runs made before this file, to find the cause; they are data, not the planted check below
exploration.cause_1: at g2 the 1.05% comes from level-0 probes inside the 0.2 m wall slabs that the 6-axis-ray test (rays of one spacing, 3 hits from behind) does not flag: their rays meet the slab from inside, the gather there finds no probe and returns 0, and room surfaces gather those dark caches through the depth test. Returning the exact value only for hits seen from inside a slab removes the error; doing so for room-side hits does not
exploration.cause_2: a 21-grid sweep (5 placements, the 8 jit phases, 8 seeded random offsets) found two more failing grids, 3.6% and 2.3% on all 96 pixels, and one at 0.018%. Cause: a probe 1 cm from a wall sees the floor straight below it, but the depth texel that holds that direction also spans the wall, so its farthest ray stops at the wall and cg 2 rejects the probe; the gather returns 0
exploration.pi_alone: fixes g2 and phase 0, not the other two grids
exploration.cg4_alone: fixes the two depth-texel grids, not g2 (cg 1 as well)

switches.pi_1: a probe also counts as inside geometry when more than half of 96 rays (the texel centres of face side 4, unbounded) meet a surface from behind. Traced once a jitter phase with the flags (static geometry); GPU flags pass bits 24 to 31
switches.cg_4: the cache gather's fallback: cg 2 first (no rays); when it keeps no probe, cg 1's segment test (a ray from the surface, lifted along its normal, to each lit-side probe outside geometry); none still gives no light. Rays only where both depth tests fail
switches.fd_1: with sv: a screen probe's merge that keeps some trusted weight but drops part of it (texels whose own start ray crossed a surface) fills the dropped part with its own ray traced on past its interval (ft's onward ray), instead of renormalising over the kept part. fd 2: every merge (world levels too). fd adds no light from past a wall: the onward ray starts on the merge's own unblocked ray

why_leak_tight: inferred, not proven. pi only removes probes from merges and gathers. cg 4 keeps a probe only when a traced segment from the surface reaches it (cg 1's test, leak-tight in round 5). fd uses the merge's own ray, whose interval up to the onward start was traced unblocked

candidates.F: J2 (h0 0.5, fix probe, stride 8, m 6, jit 8, tf 32, sv 2, ft 1, cg 2) with pi 1 and cg 4: target 1
candidates.ablations: J2 re-run as the control in this session; J2 with pi 1 alone; F with fd 2; Ffix and Gfix (no jit, no tf) for the fixed-grid leak test. Reported, not used for decisions except as stated

metrics.cpu_furnace: white furnace at 12 x 8 px, 3 bounces, started at the fixed point (as round 6), at the 21 grids of the exploration and with three plans: stride 3 m 2; stride 0; stride 3 m 2 with jit 2 tf 3. Worst relative error over hit pixels
metrics.cpu_leak: closed room at 16 x 10 px (as rounds 5 and 6) at g0 to g4 and the 8 phase grids: room B mean over 0.055
metrics.leak_closed: leak-closed-B at 960 x 540, static flags, 20 frames: frame mean luminance over the room A view's reference mean (0.0501), at g0 to g4; fixed grids (no jit) at g0 to g4 and ph4 to ph7
metrics.door_room: leak-door-B at 960 x 540: room B light ratio and relative error, reported
metrics.hall: raw-hall nave 1920 x 1080 against the 8-bounce path trace (two 1024 spp seeds): relative RMSE with the 95% 32 x 32 tile bootstrap, bias, wall and floor mottle, GI median and p5 to p95 of 50 frames, three timing runs for a candidate; 4K once for a candidate that becomes the default
metrics.band: tests/web/cascades3d_band.py: the bright-band region is every pixel where round 6's J2 1080p frame (build copy of E:/wt/raw-native-rc3d-cg/build/gi/J2-1080) has a 13 x 13 box-blurred signed luminance error above +0.15 of the reference mean (column flanks, far-wall patch, arch soffits; about 23,000 px). Metric: the mean signed error over that region, normalised by the whole frame's reference mean. The region is chosen on round 6's run and scored on this round's runs; the J2 control re-run is the baseline
metrics.parity: GPU f32 against CPU f64 on the existing 24 cases and new cases for pi, cg 4, fd 1 and fd 2, bound 2e-3 a case (unchanged)

predictions.cpu_furnace: F under 1e-6 at all 21 grids with all three plans; J2 fails at 3 or more grids
predictions.cpu_leak: F and G 0.000% at all 13 grids
predictions.leak: F and G under 1% at g0 to g4, worst under 0.4% (pi removes probes buried in the 4 cm wall, which may lower J2's seam glow); fixed grids under 1% at all 9
predictions.hall_F: RMSE 0.078 to 0.086, bias +0.5% to +1.6%, GI median 5.0 to 5.6 ms
predictions.hall_G: bias at most +0.65% (half of J2's +1.3%), RMSE at most 0.082, GI median 5.3 to 6.0 ms
predictions.band: G lowers the band's mean signed error by at least 25% against the J2 control; F by under 10%
predictions.door_room: F and G light ratio 0.7 to 1.0

pass_line: a candidate passes when (a) the CPU furnace reads under 1e-6 at all 21 grids with all three plans, (b) the closed room reads under 1% at g0 to g4 and its fixed grids under 1% at g0 to g4 and ph4 to ph7, (c) raw-hall 1080p RMSE at most 0.088 (J2's upper 95% limit in round 6), (d) the GI median of each of three 1080p timing runs under 6 ms, and (e) GPU parity within 2e-3 on every case

kill_line.target_1: pi with cg 4 is a null if F misses (a), or its worst closed-room placement reads above 1%, or it adds more than 0.5 ms of GI median over the J2 control in the same session
kill_line.target_2: fd is a null if G does not move the raw-hall bias at least halfway from the J2 control's toward zero, or misses (b) to (d)
kill_line.target_3: the band is a null for a candidate whose band mean signed error falls by under 25% against the J2 control

decisions.default: if G passes, its switches become the default of planCascades3d; else if F passes, F's. Among passing candidates the lower RMSE wins; within 0.002, the bias nearer zero. Docs and changelog say so; old tests and old parity cases pin their switches and must read as before
decisions.otherwise: keep J2 and record the nulls

budget: GPU memory under about 6 GB of the RTX 4090 shared with a training job (about 18 GB in use); never stop other processes; wait when memory is near full. At most 3 CPU workers at below-normal priority. Target 4 (4K cost) only if targets 1 to 3 leave time

amendments.text: The furnace sweep script (build/diag/furn.mjs) uses the grids g0 to g4, ph0 to ph7 and 8 seeded random offsets r0 to r7, a slightly different list from the exploration's (which had g0, g2, g3, ph4, ph7, the 8 phases and the same 8 random offsets). Phases 0 to 3 of jit 8 are g1 to g4, so both lists hold 17 distinct grids; the pass line (a) applies to the script's list. Parity cases added before their first run (bound unchanged): fb-pi-cg4-s2, fb-fd1-s2, fb-fd2-jit-s2 and furnace-fb-planted (pi 1, cg 4 at g4, where J2 reads 3.6% low on the CPU).

amendments.before: any GPU run; the CPU furnace and leak sweeps of F are re-run under this version
amendments.text: The first CPU sweep (build/diag furnF*, furnJ2*, leakF*, leakG*) read F under 1e-6 at all 21 grids with stride 3 and stride 0, but 0.074% (ph2, 56 px) and 0.022% (r1, 86 px) with the jit plan; J2 failed 8, 12 and 20 of the 21 grids with the three plans (worst 3.6%, 15.7%, 2.1%); F and G read 0.000% in the closed room at all 13 grids. Cause of F's two failures: a level-0 probe 3.5 cm above the floor inside the block reads exactly half of its 96 rays from behind, because the block's bottom face and the floor's top face are coplanar and the downward rays meet the floor first; pi required more than half. pi now flags a probe when at least half of the 96 rays meet a surface from behind (GPU: back * 2 >= 96). With that change both grids read 2e-16. F is this revised version from here on; its furnace and leak sweeps are re-run before the GPU work, and the first sweep stays in the results as the record.

amendments.text: Results so far (RTX 4090, raw-hall 1080p): F GI 6.20, 6.59, 6.39 ms (fails time; kill line met for F: +1.3 to +1.7 ms over the J2 control's 4.93 and 4.93); J2 with pi alone 4.995 ms, 0.0823, +1.36% (pi costs nothing per frame); G 7.52, 7.43, 7.58 ms, bias +1.36% (fd 1 does not move the bias: null); F with fd 2 8.18 ms, +1.51% (null). Band region (cover mask of the metric, 23k px): J2 control +0.203, F +0.205, G +0.201, B0 (round 6 run) +0.106. F5 failed the CPU furnace with the jit plan (1.16% at r4, 0.064% at r5; 0.0003% at r1 with stride 3): null. New switches: cg 6, the segment fallback over the eligible probes in decreasing weight, stopping at the first a segment reaches (one ray when the nearest is seen, up to 8); sk 1, which skips the entries of probes flagged inside geometry, since with fix probe, ft and cg no merge or gather reads them (claimed output-identical: checked by a unit test and parity). Candidate H = J2 with pi 1, cg 6 and sk 1, under the same pass line, kill lines and decision rule as F. Ablations: F with sk (sk's saving), J2 with sk. CPU furnace and leak sweeps of H run before its GPU runs. Parity cases fb-cg6-sk-s2 and fb-cg6-sk-jit-s2 added before their first run (bound unchanged).
